instruction: Candid office photograph, medium wide shot. In a modern office, the young Black man in a white dress shirt (R1) sits in a black office chair on the left, holding a blue folder and gesturing with his hands. The older bearded man in a dark gray suit (R2) sits on the right, facing left with his hands clasped on the wooden desk, listening attentively. A laptop and a pen holder sit on the desk between them. In the background, a blurred female office worker with glasses is visible at her desk. Soft, natural indoor lighting illuminates the professional meeting.
